info.name: Zebpay API Documentation
info.description:
Welcome to Zebpay!

Zebpay Build is a platform where users can create their own applications for trading like other cryptocurrency trading applications. Developers can create trading bots using Zebpay Build. Users can also build own applications (console/web/API) using our platform and will be able to:

1. Buy and Sell Crypto Assets.
2. Fetch the market data.
3. Fetch open/completed orders.
4. Cancel open orders.
5. Get the latest balance of crypto assets.

All Market and Trading related data/methods are available through REST-ful API.

  • verification_code (string): Verification code for the user

request.description:
Logout User

This endpoint is used to log out from the application.

Request Body

  • access_token (string): The access token of the user.
  • client_id (string): The client ID associated with the user.
  • client_secret (string): The client secret for authentication.

Response

  • data (object)
    • verification_code (null): The verification code.
    • access_token (null): The access token.
    • expires_in (null): The expiration time of the token.
    • token_type (null): The type of the token.
    • refresh_token (null): The refresh token.
    • message (string): Any additional message.
    • error (null): Any error code.
    • error_description (null): Description of the error.
    • publicGuid (null): Public GUID associated with the user.
  • statusCode (number): The status code of the response.
  • statusDescription (string): The description of the status.

Example Response

{
    "data": {
        "verification_code": null,
        "access_token": null,
        "expires_in": null,

Get Market Order Book

This endpoint retrieves the order book for a specific trading pair.

Request Parameters

  • Pair (path parameter) : The trading pair for which the order book is requested.

Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:

  • statusDescription : Description of the status.

  • data : Object containing the order book data.

    • symbol : The trading pair symbol.

    • bids : Array of bid orders.

    • asks : Array of ask orders.

  • statusCode : Status code of the response.

  • customMessage : Custom message related to the response.

    "data": {

        "bids": [[""]],

request.description:
Exchange Information Retrieval

This endpoint retrieves exchange information including details about trading pairs, order types, fees, leverage, precision, margin, and asset information.

Request Body:
This is a GET request and does not require a request body.

Response:

  • statusDescription (string): Description of the status.

  • data (array): Array of exchange information objects.

    • name (string): Name of the exchange.

    • pair (string): Trading pair.

    • orderTypes (array): Array of order types supported.

    • filters (array): Array of filters including max and min quantity, and filter type.

    • makerFee (number): Maker fee.

    • takerFee (number): Taker fee.

    • maxLeverage (number): Maximum leverage.

    • minLeverage (number): Minimum leverage.

    • depthGrouping (array): Array of depth grouping.

    • liquidationFee (string): Liquidation fee.

    • pricePrecision (string): Precision for price.

    • quantityPrecision (string): Precision for quantity.

    • maintenanceMarginPercentage (string): Maintenance margin percentage.

    • marginBufferPercentage (string): Margin buffer percentage.

    • marginBuffer (string): Margin buffer.

    • reduceMarginAllowedRatioPercent (number): Reduce margin allowed ratio percentage.

    • iconURL (string): URL for the exchange icon.

    • baseAsset (string): Base asset for the trading pair.

    • quoteAsset (string): Quote asset for the trading pair.

  • statusCode (number): Status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array): Array of custom messages.

request.description:
Retrieve Trade History

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve trade history data from the specified page.

Request Parameters

  • page (integer) - The page number for the trade history.

  • timestamp (string) - The timestamp for the trade history.

  • pageSize (integer) - The number of items per page.

Response

The response will be in JSON format with the following structure:

  • statusDescription (string) - Description of the status.

  • data (object) - Contains trade history data.

    • totalCount (integer) - Total count of trade history items.

    • nextTimestamp (integer) - Timestamp for the next page of trade history.

    • data (array) - Array of trade history items with the following properties:

      • id (integer) - Trade ID.

      • time (string) - Timestamp of the trade.

      • symbol (string) - Trading symbol.

      • type (string) - Type of trade.

      • side (string) - Trade side.

      • price (float) - Trade price.

      • quantity (float) - Trade quantity.

      • role (string) - Role in the trade.

      • fee (float) - Trade fee.

      • feeInMarginAsset (float) - Trade fee in margin asset.

      • realizedProfit (float) - Realized profit from the trade.

      • realizedProfitInMarginAsset (float) - Realized profit in margin asset.

      • contractType (string) - Type of contract.

      • clientOrderId (string) - Client order ID.

      • baseAsset (string) - Base asset for the trade.

      • quoteAsset (string) - Quote asset for the trade.

      • marginAsset (string) - Margin asset for the trade.

      • positionId (string) - Position ID for the trade.

      • iconUrl (string) - URL for trade icon.

  • statusCode (integer) - Status code of the response.

  • customMessage (array) - Custom message array.

The endpoint retrieves the transaction history for trades.

    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "statusDescription": {
            "type": "string"
        },
        "data": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "totalCount": {
                    "type": "integer"
                },
                "nextTimestamp": {
                    "type": "integer"
                },
                "data": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "id": {
                                "type": "integer"
                            },
                            "tradeId": {
                                "type": "integer"
                            },
                            "positionId": {
                                "type": ["integer", "null"]
                            },
                            "time": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "type": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "amount": {
                                "type": "integer"
                            },
                            "asset": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "symbol": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "contractType": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "baseAsset": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "quoteAsset": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "iconUrl": {
                                "type": "string"
                            }
                        },
                        "required": ["id", "tradeId", "time", "type", "amount", "asset", "symbol", "contractType", "baseAsset", "quoteAsset", "iconUrl"]
                    }
                }
            },
            "required": ["totalCount", "nextTimestamp", "data"]

        "statusCode": {
            "type": "integer"
        },
        "customMessage": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
                "type": "string"
            }
        }
    },
    "required": ["data", "statusCode"]
}

Retrieve User Leverage Preferences

This endpoint allows you to retrieve the user's leverage preferences.

Request Body
This is a GET request and does not require a request body.

Response Body
The response will be a JSON object with the following schema:

{
    "statusDescription": "string",
    "data": {
        "leveragePreferences": [
            {
                "contractName": "string",
                "leverage": 0,
                "openPositionCount": 0
            }
        ],
        "favouritePair": []
    },
    "statusCode": 0,
    "customMessage": [ "string" ]
}

The response contains:

  • statusDescription: A string describing the status.

  • data: An object containing user leverage preferences and favorite pairs.

    • leveragePreferences: An array of objects with contract name, leverage, and open position count.

      • contractName: The name of the contract.

      • leverage: The leverage value.

      • openPositionCount: The count of open positions.

    • favouritePair: An array of favorite pairs.

  • statusCode: The status code of the response.

  • customMessage: An array of custom messages.
